documented_observed_mismatches.description: Bootstrap-request business context (user-provided, not a formal spec) asserts both Product Page Content and Dynamic Translations propagate to storefront. Observed via APIOP-006: Product Page Content DOES propagate (through a mechanism outside this endpoint — see APIOP-002/coverage_limitations), but Dynamic Translations does NOT propagate through this endpoint's response, in either locale, despite the underlying record (APIOP-003, id=69) existing and being correctly saved on the portal side. This is a mismatch between stated business expectation and observed API behavior — neither side has been chosen as 'correct'; both are recorded (also see conflicts[] and storefront-evidence.json's own conflicts[]).

APIOP-002 (config-translations) and APIOP-003 (translations/bulk) use materially different storage/key models for what the portal UI presents as two flavors of the same 'Translation' object: APIOP-002 uses fixed semantic keys (e.g. form_header_title) with a full-default-plus-sparse-override shape; APIOP-003 uses the literal free-text source string as the data key with no full/sparse distinction observed. No documented API spec exists to compare against (ZERO_DOC_BOOTSTRAP) — this is an internal-consistency observation, not a doc-vs-observed mismatch in the strict sense, recorded here for downstream normalizer awareness.
